bonuses.name: Mutative
bonuses.text: Whenever a Mutant deals a Wound, the GM gains +1 Ruin.

abilities.name: Sticky Fingers
abilities.text: A target within 2m must succeed on an opposed Strength Test or drop a random piece of Wargear.

abilities.name: Desperation
abilities.text: Whenever a piece of Wargear is dropped within 18m of a Mutant, they Sprint toward it and pick it up as a Reflexive Action. Their Defence is reduced by 2 for the next Round.
